mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_equipment WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_equipment WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM t_equipment WHERE equipment_code = #{equipmentCode} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_equipment (equipment_code, equipment_name, equipment_type, model, manufacturer, purchase_date, warranty_period, location, status, responsible_id, responsible_name, remark, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{equipmentCode}, #{equipmentName}, #{equipmentType}, #{model}, #{manufacturer}, #{purchaseDate}, #{warrantyPeriod}, #{location}, #{status}, #{responsibleId}, #{responsibleName}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_equipment SET equipment_code = #{equipmentCode}, equipment_name = #{equipmentName}, equipment_type = #{equipmentType}, model = #{model}, manufacturer = #{manufacturer}, purchase_date = #{purchaseDate}, warranty_period = #{warrantyPeriod}, location = #{location}, status = #{status}, responsible_id = #{responsibleId}, responsible_name = #{responsibleName}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = #{updateTime}, is_deleted = #{isDeleted} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: UPDATE t_equipment SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
